browser.method: CDP Performance.getMetrics at the beginning and after the 15-minute idle window; no forced garbage collection

backend.method: PowerShell Get-Process sampling every 30 seconds for 31 points over 900.818 seconds; process remained alive

result: During this fixed two-page idle sample, DOM/listener counts stayed constant and backend working set, private memory and handles varied only slightly. JS heap changed with ordinary browser allocation and garbage collection; this is a bounded idle observation, not proof of no leak or a per-canvas memory limit.
scope: Self-made 100-node samples with one repeated 320x240 PNG; no generation, video, high-resolution media, concurrent canvases or real providers.
